verdict.rationale: Muse's own docs say that once a goal or task is set, it keeps working "on a schedule and in response to relevant events" (muse-docs-20). These ongoing tasks are tracked and managed in the Goals tab (muse-docs-5), and Muse continues monitoring and following up after the app is closed (muse-docs-26). That shows recurring, autonomous work, but nothing documents user-defined recurring schedules or how users would configure cadence or timing for a repeatable workflow. missing for 10: explicit user-configurable recurrence/cadence controls, documentation of scheduled workflow definitions, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs.
